text:
lucy: Quick preflight check — evening tilt incoming. Planning prewarm: AMS1 40 GPUs, APAC1 30 GPUs for 19:00 UTC ramp. Also want spot fallback to us-east if eviction spike. Any blockers?

alex: On it, running cost sim now. If we use 8-bit quant for the canary model we save ~22% on token compute. Will post numbers in 5.

priya: FYI CR#842 (autoscaler:spillover-fallback) still needs review. It's blocking the auto-fallback rule. pinging @alex for perf approval.

jin: I can run perf tests on the canary binary. Prefer to hold rollout until 18:45 UTC so I can run two load curves, ok?

ops-bot: snapshot @ 2026-03-18T17:00Z — AMS1 free GPUs: 34/120, APAC1 free GPUs: 18/80, us-east free GPUs: 96/200, spot eviction risk: low->medium.

sam: Heads-up — queued longjob #6789 will grab 12 GPUs in AMS starting 18:30 UTC. Might overlap the warmup window.

alex: Posted cost sim: https://redwood.internal/ops/cost-sims/tilt-march18 — using q4 quant reduces peak mem by ~30% and lowers per-token cost. :thumbsup:

priya: Updated CR#842 with a unit test for the fallback policy and a short RFC note. @jin please run the smoke; I wired the metrics tags.

jin: Running smoke now (load profile: 50rps -> 150rps ramp). Sharing logs in a sec. If green I'll approve. Suggest canary 10% then monitor 15m.

deploy-bot: queued rollout: canary 10% -> if stable auto 50% after 15m. Scheduled start: 18:50 UTC. Pending approvals: 1 (jin).

lucy: Thanks — plan: hold until jin confirms smoke at ~18:40-18:45, then kick canary 18:50. I'll update on-call + support channel and add a short note in the runbook. TL;DR: prewarm as above, spot fallback to us-east, await jin approval.
